tools.name: list_periods
tools.title: List available reporting periods
tools.description: List the distinct reporting periods (date_start / date_stop) available in the Meta Ads and Google Ads data, including quarter labels when applicable.

tools.name: get_dashboard_summary
tools.title: Get Radiocom dashboard summary
tools.description: Return a blended marketing performance summary across Meta Ads and Google Ads: total spend, leads, impressions, clicks, blended cost-per-lead, CTR and CPC. Optionally scope to one reporting period returned by list_periods.

date_start.description: Period start date (YYYY-MM-DD) from list_periods. Omit for all-time totals.

date_stop.description: Period end date (YYYY-MM-DD) from list_periods. Required if date_start is provided.

tools.name: get_olx_products
tools.title: Get OLX product performance
tools.description: Return product-level performance from the OLX listings: name, price, views, favorites (likes), phone clicks and CTR. Optionally limit the number of rows and sort by a metric.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. Defaults to 25.

sort_by.description: Metric to sort by, descending. Defaults to views.

tools.name: get_organic_stats
tools.title: Get organic social stats
tools.description: Return organic social performance periods for Facebook or Instagram: reach, impressions, follower changes, and per-metric breakdown.

channel.description: Which organic channel to report on.
